sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • ## 1.3.0
  • **New**
  • Scheduled full-site backups (daily / weekly / monthly) with retention and a failure e-mail.
  • Security: block PHP in the uploads folder (with a real "Test now" check), optional block on plugin/theme installs, and e-mail alerts for new-address admin sign-ins, lockouts, new admins and plugin/theme changes.
  • Site Health tests and a Debug Info section.
  • Performance: Heartbeat control, revision limit with cleanup, autosave interval.
  • HTML blocks: `&&`, `||`, parentheses, comparisons and `in` in conditions; `data-class`; `data-limit`, `data-offset`, `data-for-empty`; more `data-supports` panels.
  • Media: virtual folders in the native Media Library; Forms entries are split by language.
  • Docs in English and Traditional Chinese are updated.
